body:
Fixes #378. Pass 2 of the post-CMA simplification audit (#376 / #377). Four commits: the momentum assembly removal per ruling, the nix research retirement, the CMA test-tree remnant purge, and a method-level reachability audit that deletes the remaining production-dead code. Production loses ~1,900 lines in this PR plus the ALM+snap cluster (2686 lines) moved out of the shipped jars; the test tree loses the ~9,800-line nix probe corpus.

## Commit 1: momentum assembly removal (ruling)

Contribution audit over the full hpk sweep (104 FAST runs) and the solve corpus: `peel` won 2 of 6 executions, `seedMulti` 3/9, `freeRescue` 2/4, `rescueBnb` 1/2; **`momentumAssembly` 0/5 while burning the largest single budget** (116 s measured). Kill-audit: ProblemsTest 111/111 with the node hard-disabled, ~80 s faster. Its only recorded win was "CMA-ES -> momentum assembly" on nix-full-t1, dead since #374. Deleted outright with its node, params, stage and budget; the momentum gate router survives only in stop-on-feasible graphs as the scored-feasibility fork (renamed `rImproveFeas`); old presets with the node get the existing "Unknown node type" rejection. Also in this commit: `PathTranslation` extracted, the ALM+snap cluster (SnapRepairPolish.run, AlmBfgsCore, SmoothJumpProblem, FacingReconstruction) moved to the test tree, and two bit-identical `CostateDualSolver` hoists (a JFR line profile put 31.5% of all solver CPU on a per-tick sqrt recomputed per constraint pair).

## Commits 2 + 3: nix research retirement (ruling)

The 26 Nix* probe screens, PatternPinnedProbe and the PKC_CLOSER / PKC_ASSEMBLY probe blocks deleted; with their last users gone, `HomotopyCloser`, `SolveCore`, `CmaesJumpHarness` and `SolverRunResult` are deleted outright (IlsPolishTest inlines the one trivial helper it used; RazorBench loses its env-gated CMA warm-seed arm). All nix-named captures stay: they are wired solve-corpus problems.

## Commit 4: reachability audit

Bytecode call graph with class-hierarchy analysis from the loader entry points over all of core/main, cross-checked by source-level caller search. Class-level: all 196 remaining classes reachable. Method-level finds and deletes:

- **The solve-from-blocks pipeline** (solveFromBlocks, its BlockJob plumbing, the poll() derived-constraints branch, `BlockSolver`, `SweptCollision`): superseded by the one-press B constraint derivation; no UI has called it since, zero test users.
- **The advance-node feature** (engine advanceNode, GraphContext.advance, NodeType.advanceCapable, its only test): never exposed by any UI.
- Thirteen dead methods with no callers anywhere (ConstraintSelection.hasFocus, FacingPrefold.reducedVars, InputOverlay.tableContentHeight, JumpConstraintCompiler.penalty/translatedPenalty, JumpLinearModel.precompute, ParamValues.specs, SettingsModal.buildScaleLabels, SolveRunLog.getRunsDir, StartStateTable.setExpanded, YawTies.fullLength, VelocityFinder.fieldNode/objectiveAxis/objectiveIsMax).

Kept deliberately despite being production-dead: intentional test hooks (debugBuildSpec, setAutoSaveIntervalNanosForTests, awaitPendingCapture) and APIs the slow-suite gates drive (the VelocityFinder sweep/field API for the J008 suites, translatedEvaluate/translatedSlack for TranslationEliminationTest, the JumpLinearModel magnitude accessors, WrapWindowIls.maxAbs, the UndoController state accessors). Follow-up ruling applied: `SimulationRunner.tryMoveTick` + MoveTickTest deleted (superseded by the rigid shift-drag StartDragGate, which bisects and clamps instead of the one-shot accept/reject); the tolerance constant the live gate borrowed is renamed DEFAULT_DRAG_TOLERANCE.

## Results

- hpk sweep: 71.5 s -> **57.1 s** at 104/104 solved, no capture slower.
- `:core:check -PslowTests` green at 3m10s (was 3m41s before this PR).
- Line-profile self-time before the hoists: dual Newton 45.9%, commons-math simplex 16.0%, byte-exact forward 13.2%, wrap-close scoring 12.9%.

## Behavior notes for QA

- Momentum-heavy specs that end infeasible no longer spend up to 240 s in momentum assembly; nothing in either corpus lost a solve.
- Old saved presets with a momentumAssembly node are rejected with the existing clear message.
- Historical mentions in docs/research stay as records, same as with the CMA removal.
- A staged wrap-close budget was tried for the j716 class and reverted: the gh283-j925-farseed close converges at ~2.96 s, exactly on a 3 s stage boundary, and the split made the pin fail under suite load.
title: feat(solver): remove momentum assembly and simplify the solver hot paths
